title: Optional application packet flush cadence verification
scope: Verify independently forceable legacy_current and prompt packet_flush_cadence values, exact one-opportunity semantics, bounded observation and unified provenance, exact sample-scoped raw joins, authoritative safety fallback, terminal and cancellation behavior, and force-legacy rollback without making a performance or active-behavior claim.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home tests, schema and semantic validation, and focused application-send delay, packet opportunity, FIN, cancellation, terminal, package, and ownership correctness tests.
preconditions: Stage 0, all four Stage 1 axes, buffer_copy_coalescing, and adaptive_backpressure remain preserved.
receive_credit_publication and every adjacent applied policy remain legacy_current.
The stopped 55,658-epoch single-axis transform remains diagnostic_incomplete and untouched.
Performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI work, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate the Stage 3 specification, architecture, work item, and verification artifacts against the canonical model and reciprocal links.
Build the affected runtime, test project, and raw host in Release before testing.
Verify closed legacy_current and prompt values plus invalid closed-set rejection.
Verify disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-prompt modes with all identities, source, reason, safety, latch, fallback, and version fields distinct.
Verify legacy_current retains the optional one-millisecond delay and prompt removes only that delay for an otherwise eligible application write smaller than 32 bytes.
Verify the decision occurs after payload construction and is latched for one logical-write packet opportunity.
Verify retransmission, address-validation, lifecycle, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, and out-of-domain inputs fall back to legacy_current even under prompt forcing.
Verify simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing of any adjacent adaptive axis is rejected.
Verify force-legacy rollback restores the optional delay and preserves packet, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, lifecycle, cancellation, terminal, and ownership authority.
Verify the configured policy snapshot remains in a unified epoch when no opportunity is observed.
Verify packet observation, epoch, raw, unified evidence v9, unified raw v9, and manifest v10 schemas.
Verify packet rows remain sample-scoped and join by exact source, connection key, and operation sequence.
Verify missing, duplicate, orphan, and out-of-order raw opportunities fail semantic validation and bounded aggregates are recomputed.
Run focused package, application-send delay, FIN, cancellation, terminal, and ownership tests.
Confirm no performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
expected_result: packet_flush_cadence is observable, shadowable, independently forceable, unified-row represented, guarded, and force-legacy rollback tested; prompt removes only the existing optional small-write delay; sample and epoch evidence remains exactly attributable; and no active or performance decision is introduced.
status_summary: Focused implementation verification is clean: the runtime seam, unified v9 evidence, raw v1 sample stream, schemas, exact joins, 19 axis cases, and the 136-case affected correctness band pass in Release. All four Stage 3 SpecTrace artifacts pass the canonical model, ID uniqueness, and reciprocal trace checks. Measurement and active behavior remain frozen.
